LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Vanilla.Gaunt.Label: Gaunt head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Vanilla.Gaunt.Desc: Gives the Head_Gaunt gene (wasters and friends) a Facial Animation head type instead of a vanilla one.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Vanilla.HeavyJaw.Label: Heavy jaw head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Vanilla.HeavyJaw.Desc: Gives the Jaw_Heavy gene (neanderthals and friends) a Facial Animation head type instead of a vanilla one.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Vanilla.PigNose.Label: Pig nose head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Vanilla.PigNose.Desc: Bakes the Nose_Pig gene's snout into a Facial Animation head instead of drawing it as a render node over the face.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Vanilla.YttakinHair.Label: Yttakin - allow hair
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Vanilla.YttakinHair.Desc: Drops Hair_BaldOnly from the Yttakin xenotype so they can roll hair styles.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.AlphaGenes.FoxFace.Label: Fox face
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.AlphaGenes.FoxFace.Desc: Replaces AG_FoxFace's forced vanilla head types with a Facial Animation canine-snout head.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.AlphaGenes.AnimusEars.Label: Animus ears
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.AlphaGenes.AnimusEars.Desc: Swaps AG_AnimusEars over to this mod's canine ear texture, hair-coloured and off the skin shader.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.AlphaGenes.Drakonori.Label: Drakonori head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.AlphaGenes.Drakonori.Desc: Gives AG_DrakonoriHead the shared dragon-snout Facial Animation head, with a blank mouth so the snout reads as one piece.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.AlphaGenes.RockSpurs.Label: Rock spurs head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.AlphaGenes.RockSpurs.Desc: Bakes AG_RockSpurs' facial rock growths into a Facial Animation head instead of overlaying them as a render node.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.AlphaGenes.VenomFangs.Label: Venom fangs - hide overlay
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.AlphaGenes.VenomFangs.Desc: Drops AG_VenomFangs' render node, which otherwise draws fangs across a Facial Animation mouth.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.BigAndSmall.GhoulHead.Label: Ghoul head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.BigAndSmall.GhoulHead.Desc: Gives BS_GhoulHead a Facial Animation head type.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.BigAndSmall.DragonHead.Label: Dragonhead broodmother
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.BigAndSmall.DragonHead.Desc: Gives BS_DragonHead the shared dragon-snout Facial Animation head plus a blank mouth, in place of its own render node.
Gives BS_OgreHead proper Facial Animation head types - one per art variant - in place of its forced heads and overlay render node. Art from the source mod, used with permission.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.BigAndSmall.OgreHeadLumpy.De: Gives BS_FomorialHead_Savage proper Facial Animation head types - one per art variant - in place of its forced heads and overlay render node. Art from the source mod, used with permission.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.BigAndSmall.SatanHead.Label: Satan head - keep the face
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.BigAndSmall.SatanHead.Desc: Stops BS_SatanHead disabling facial animations, and lifts its overlay to layer 50 so it draws above the animated face.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.BigAndSmall.StonemaskHead.De: Stops BS_StonemaskHead disabling facial animations, and lifts its overlay to layer 50 so it draws above the animated face.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.BigAndSmall.InsectoidFourArm: Makes sure the four-armed insectoid race has the Facial Animation comps, sizes its face to its head, and labels its eyes as compound eyes. Switched off, the race falls back to Facial Animation's default face size and position. The race normally inherits Facial Animation from Human, so switching this off may not remove the face itself.
LanguageData.FACP.Category.Lamias: Big and Small - Lamias and other Snake-People
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Lamias.SnekSnoot.Label: Snake snout head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Lamias.SnekSnoot.Desc: Gives LoS_SnekSnoot the shared dragon-snout Facial Animation head plus a blank mouth, in place of its forced head types.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Slimes.SludgeBody.Label: Sludge body - use normal heads
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Slimes.SludgeBody.Desc: Drops BS_SludgeBody's forced head types and its eyeless slime head node, so slimes render an ordinary animated face.
LanguageData.FACP.Category.Undead: Big and Small - Vampires and the Undead
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Undead.WerewolfSnoot.Label: Werewolf snout head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Undead.WerewolfSnoot.Desc: Gives BS_WerewolfSnoot the shared canine-snout Facial Animation head in place of its forced head types.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Undead.WerewolfForm.Label: Werewolf form - keep the face
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Undead.WerewolfForm.Desc: Stops the werewolf transformation hediff disabling facial animations, and swaps its ears over to this mod's canine ear texture.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Yokai.LesserOni.Label: Lesser oni - enable faces
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Yokai.LesserOni.Desc: Drops BS_FacialAnimDisabled from the lesser oni xenotype so they get an animated face.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Bogleg.FatSac.Label: Fat sac jaw head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Bogleg.FatSac.Desc: Bakes DV_Jaw_FatSac's throat sac into a Facial Animation head, and drops Head_Gaunt from the bogleg xenotype so it does not fight the new head.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Bogleg.Whiskers.Label: Barbels - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Bogleg.Whiskers.Desc: Points the barbel gene at this mod's upscaled, realigned barbel textures. Switched off, Boglegs draws its own art, which the replacement is deliberately not aligned to.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Brawnum.Snout.Label: Snout head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Brawnum.Snout.Desc: Bakes DV_Nose_Snout into a Facial Animation head instead of overlaying it as a render node.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Brawnum.Bonechin.Label: Bone chin - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Brawnum.Bonechin.Desc: Points the bone chin gene at this mod's realigned chin textures. Switched off, Brawnum draws its own art, which the replacement is deliberately not aligned to.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Brawnum.BovineEars.Label: Bovine ears - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Brawnum.BovineEars.Desc: Points the drooped ear gene at this mod's realigned ear texture. Switched off, Brawnum draws its own art, which the replacement is deliberately not aligned to.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Venators.DownturnedEars.Desc: Points the downturned ear gene at this mod's realigned ear textures. Switched off, Venators draws its own art, which the replacement is deliberately not aligned to.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Oni.Ears.Label: Oni ears - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Oni.Ears.Desc: Points the oni ear gene at this mod's realigned ear textures. Switched off, Oni Xenotype draws its own art, which the replacement is deliberately not aligned to.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Keshig.SplitJaw.Label: Split jaw head and mouth
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Keshig.SplitJaw.Desc: Replaces DV_Jaw_Split's forced head types with a Facial Animation head plus a matching split-jaw mouth type.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Stoneborn.BushyEyebrows.Desc: Adds a zero-probability blank brow type for DV_BushyEyebrows, so the gene's own brow art is not doubled up by an animated one.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Auraeyl.Head.Label: Auraeyl head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Auraeyl.Head.Desc: Swaps the Auraeyl head for this mod's version, drawn under a transparent Facial Animation head so the animated eyes and mouth sit on top of it. Keeps the pawn's primary and secondary fur colours, matching the body from the moment they spawn.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Auraeyl.SyncSkinColour.Label: Auraeyl skin follows fur colour
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Auraeyl.SyncSkinColour.Desc: Applies the pawn's primary fur colour to its skin the moment the gene rolls its colours, so the head and eyelid are right from the start instead of needing the fur colour gizmo. Needs Harmony; without it this does nothing and the colour has to be set by hand, as Erin's mod documents.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Auronya.Head.Label: Auronya head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Auronya.Head.Desc: Drops ERN_AuronyaHead's forced head types in favour of a Facial Animation head, so the muzzle keeps Facial Animation's own eyes.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Auronya.Whiskers.Label: Auronya whiskers
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Auronya.Whiskers.Desc: Hangs whiskers off the Auronya head gene so they draw with the Facial Animation head, leaving the pawn's beard slot free. Hair-coloured.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Fenrisulfr.Head.Label: Fenrisúlfr head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Fenrisulfr.Head.Desc: Drops ERN_FenrisulfrHead's forced head types in favour of a Facial Animation head, so the muzzle keeps Facial Animation's own eyes.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Expie.Head.Label: Expie head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Expie.Head.Desc: Adds a Facial Animation head type for ERN_ExpieHead.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Shisune.Head.Label: Shisune head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Shisune.Head.Desc: Adds a Facial Animation head type for ERN_ShisuneHead.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Rhyaeth.Head.Label: Rhyaeth head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Rhyaeth.Head.Desc: Gives ERN_RhyaethHead the shared dragon-snout Facial Animation head plus a blank mouth, in place of its forced head types.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Rhyaeth.FaceOverlays.Label: Face overlays - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Rhyaeth.FaceOverlays.Desc: Points the ear, horn, frill and whisker genes at this mod's realigned overlay art. Switched off, Rhy'aeth draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Starlet.Ridge.Label: Facial ridges head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Starlet.Ridge.Desc: Gives GS_Ridge a Facial Animation head with the ridges painted in, and removes the gene's own ridge overlay. The ridges run through the eyes, which an overlay cannot do without either being painted over by the eyelids or drawing across the eyeball.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Geist.BlankFace.Label: Faceless - blank eyes, lids and brows
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Geist.BlankFace.Desc: Gives GS_Skullplate_Head fully transparent Facial Animation eyes, eyelids and brows, so the Geist's featureless skull stays featureless.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Dioktri.SnakeTongue.Label: Snake tongue mouths
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Dioktri.SnakeTongue.Desc: Removes Gene_SnakeTongue's tongue overlay and gives carriers their own list of Facial Animation mouths with the tongue drawn in, so it moves with the animated mouth. Mirrors the normal mouth list: one snake mouth on plain Facial Animation; with FA - Experimentals, snake copies of its normal, fang and shark mouths.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Kabouter.BulbousNose.Label: Bulbous nose - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Kabouter.BulbousNose.Desc: Points GS_bulbous_Gnose at this mod's nose texture, which sits further back so it joins a Facial Animation face instead of floating just outside the outline. Switched off, Kabouter draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Kabouter.FluffyBrows.Label: Fluffy eyebrows - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Kabouter.FluffyBrows.Desc: Points GS_Fluffy_Eyebrows at this mod's eyebrow texture. Switched off, Kabouter draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Kabouter.HighPointEars.Label: High-pointy ears - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Kabouter.EarlessHead.Label: Earless head for high-pointy ears
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Kabouter.EarlessHead.Desc: Gives pawns with GS_GHigh_Pointy an earless Facial Animation head, so the head's own ears do not show underneath the gene's.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Kabouter.BlankBrow.Label: Fluffy eyebrows - blank animated brow
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Kabouter.BlankBrow.Desc: Gives pawns with GS_Fluffy_Eyebrows a transparent Facial Animation brow, so the animated brows do not draw over the gene's own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Kabouter.HighPointEars.Desc: Points GS_GHigh_Pointy at this mod's ear texture. Switched off, Kabouter draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Molong.Skinhorns.Label: Skin-horns - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Molong.Skinhorns.Desc: Points GS_Headbone_Skinhorns at this mod's horn texture. Switched off, Molong draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Molong.FiendEars.Label: Fiend ears - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Molong.FiendEars.Desc: Points GS_Ears_MFiend at this mod's ear texture. Switched off, Molong draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Molong.BigNose.Label: Big nose - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Molong.BigNose.Desc: Points GS_BigNose at this mod's nose texture (and, for women, its blank one). Switched off, Molong draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Molong.TigerEye.Label: Eye of the tiger - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Molong.TigerEye.Desc: Points the eye of the tiger implant's overlay at this mod's texture. Switched off, Molong draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Molong.FiendEarless.Label: Earless head for fiend head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Molong.FiendEarless.Desc: Gives pawns with GS_FiendHead an earless Facial Animation head, so the head's own ears do not show underneath the fiend ears.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Korg.Head.Label: Korg head for brute head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Korg.Head.Desc: Gives pawns with GS_Head_Brute a Facial Animation head drawn for the Korg.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Korg.StubbyEars.Label: Stubby ears - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Korg.StubbyEars.Desc: Points GS_Stubby_Ear at this mod's ear texture. Switched off, Korg draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Korg.SmushedNose.Label: Smushed nose - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Korg.SmushedNose.Desc: Points GS_smushed_nose at this mod's nose texture. Switched off, Korg draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Korg.Tusks.Label: Tusks - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Korg.Tusks.Desc: Points GS_Tusks at this mod's tusk texture. Switched off, Korg draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Korg.Mouth.Label: Large mouth for tusks
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Korg.Mouth.Desc: Gives pawns with GS_Tusks a Facial Animation mouth three times the normal size, its corners meeting the tusks, and draws the tusks in front of it. Matches Facial Animation - Experimentals when that is installed.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Elves.EarlessHead.Label: Earless head for sharp ears
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Elves.EarlessHead.Desc: Gives pawns with Ears_HighSharp, Ears_MidSharp or Ears_LowSharp an earless Facial Animation head, so the head's own ears do not show underneath the gene's.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.RimElves.EarlessHead.Label: Earless head for pointed ears
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.RimElves.EarlessHead.Desc: Gives pawns with Ears_Pointed an earless Facial Animation head, so the head's own ears do not show underneath the gene's. The gene is vanilla's, so this reaches every pawn with pointed ears while Rim-Elves is loaded, not only elves.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Faun.DeerHead.Label: Deer heads
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Faun.DeerHead.Desc: Replaces RBSF_DeerHead's forced head types with four Facial Animation deer heads, rolled evenly.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Minotaur.BovineHead.Label: Bovine heads
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Minotaur.BovineHead.Mode.Fac: Swaps the forced head types for nine Facial Animation bovine heads and this mod's horn attachment, giving a fully animated face.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Minotaur.BovineHead.Mode.Eye: Keeps the source mod's own bovine heads and markings, and lets Facial Animation draw only the eyes, lids and brows over them. The animated head and mouth are blanked, since neither would line up with the bovine muzzle.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Minotaur.BovineHead.Mode.Off: Minotaurs render exactly as their own mod draws them, with no animated face.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Minotaur.NoseRing.Label: Nose ring - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Minotaur.NoseRing.Desc: Points the source mod's nose ring marking at this mod's ring texture. Only has an effect in the "original heads" mode, where the source mod's own markings are the ones drawing.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Lycanthrope.CanineNose.Label: Canine nose head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Lycanthrope.CanineNose.Desc: Bakes VRE_CanineNose into the shared canine-snout Facial Animation head instead of overlaying it as a render node.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Lycanthrope.CanineEars.Label: Canine ears - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Lycanthrope.CanineEars.Desc: Points VRE's own canine ear gene at this mod's ear texture. Switched off, Lycanthrope draws its own ears; the Alpha Genes and werewolf patches keep using ours either way.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Lycanthrope.WolfTail.Label: Wolf tail - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Lycanthrope.WolfTail.Desc: Points the canine tail gene at this mod's realigned tail art. Switched off, Lycanthrope draws its own.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Phytokin.BarkSkin.Label: Barkskin head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Phytokin.BarkSkin.Desc: Adds a Facial Animation head type for VRE_BarkSkin.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Sanguophage.EarlessHead.Desc: Gives pawns with VRE_BatEars or VRE_UpperBatEars an earless Facial Animation head, so the head's own ears do not show underneath the gene's.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Sanguophage.EkkimianGaunt.La: Ekkimian - drop the gaunt head gene
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Sanguophage.EkkimianGaunt.De: Removes Head_Gaunt from the Ekkimian xenotype. The earless head above needs this: the gaunt gene has a Facial Animation head of its own, with ears, and Facial Animation picks at random between every head a pawn's genes qualify for - so with the gene left in, about half of Ekkimians would show a second pair of ears under their chiropteric ones. Switch this off to give Ekkimians the gaunt gene back. Does nothing while the earless head is off.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Sanguophage.BatEars.Label: Bat ears - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Sanguophage.BatEars.Desc: Points VRE_BatEars at this mod's ear texture. Switched off, Sanguophage draws its own - or whichever retexture mod is shadowing that path.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Sanguophage.UpperBatEars.Des: Points VRE_UpperBatEars at this mod's ear texture. Switched off, Sanguophage draws its own - or whichever retexture mod is shadowing that path.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Sanguophage.BatNose.Label: Bat nose - replacement art
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Sanguophage.BatNose.Desc: Points VRE_BatNose at this mod's nose texture. Switched off, Sanguophage draws its own - or whichever retexture mod is shadowing that path.
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Saurid.ScaleSkin.Label: Scaled skin head
LanguageData.FACP.Toggle.Saurid.ScaleSkin.Desc: Adds a Facial Animation head type for VRESaurids_ScaleSkin.
